evaluation_diagnostics.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid, arm's-length pilot in which an advisor is the contracting payer, brings at least one consenting regulated client, passes that client's security and procurement review, and demonstrates against the free official stack and a priced specialist alternative: lower expert hours and rework, accurate source lineage and exports, acceptable deployment and support cost, positive partner payback, software-like contribution margin, and written intent to renew and activate additional client entities.
evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Reduce the product to a signed, self-hosted validation-and-lineage engine that plugs into advisors' existing collection and remediation workflows, and sell it only through anchor partners that prepay a minimum multi-client reporting-cycle commitment. This removes most contract hosting and workflow replacement, makes partner economics observable, and prevents the business from depending on optional per-entity adoption without committed portfolio volume.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The partner-aligned, customer-controlled architecture preserves the advisor's service revenue while concentrating the vendor on repeatable provenance, validation, and export infrastructure that can potentially serve multiple regulated entities through each partner.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: The critical commercial control point is hypothetical: no advisor has agreed to pay, bring repeat client volume, secure end-client permission, or operate the runtime, and partner intermediation may not remove the underlying vendor's security and procurement burden.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Regulators already provide free templates, data models, validation materials, forms, and training, while ServiceNow and a publicly priced DORA specialist already cover register workflows; this shows that reporting friction can be addressed without the proposed entrant and places direct pressure on both differentiation and price.

evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Narrow the initial paid offer to a partner-branded, no-data-egress remediation appliance for rejected or imminent submissions, sold per reporting cycle under a minimum-volume advisor commitment; defer the broader annual platform model until repeated paid use and renewal are observed.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The advisor-as-payer and prime-contractor structure can align the product with existing remediation revenue, aggregate distribution across several end entities, and keep the technically matched founder away from continuous direct client delivery.

Keep the conditional anchor contract, but put site access, CPO duties, and local exception response under that partner's enforceable operating responsibility so the business sells a measurable enterprise availability layer without independently recreating a distributed charging operation.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The design targets the physical reliability gap that generic charging software does not solve, while demand-gating supply commitments and reusing an incumbent compliance stack to limit speculative capital and product build.

evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make each cluster a simultaneous back-to-back closing: a paid fleet capacity audit leads to a conditional take-or-pay contract, matching conditional host and fallback rights, and a delegated operator SLA that all become effective only after technical, legal, and contribution tests pass, with hard walk-away triggers if any leg fails.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: Demand-first activation ties revenue to capacity commitments and differentiates the offer around enforceable physical availability and operational reliability instead of commoditized booking software.

A signed contribution-positive take-or-pay anchor agreement matched to enforceable host and fallback rights, followed by a paid pilot showing delivered availability, blocked-bay and fault rates, operator minutes, service credits, full contribution margin, renewal intent, and a repeatable partner-led sales cycle.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid pilot in which an established advisor is the contracting payer, deploys the runtime in a consenting client's real reporting workflow, passes the client's security and procurement requirements, and then activates it for a second client. The pilot should measure baseline versus achieved expert hours, validation defects, rework, deployment and support hours, gross margin, cycle payback, and renewal intent against the official stack and a specialist competitor.
records.primary_score_limiter: The entire commercial model depends on an unverified intermediary behavior: an advisor must pay, carry the product across multiple clients, obtain client permission, and still leave enough recurring software margin after deployment and support; partner intermediation may not actually bypass end-client procurement.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Entities can use free official EBA and KNF materials and training, while both ServiceNow and a lower-priced DORA-native product already cover register maintenance, validation, and export; the supplied research found no evidence of advisor commitment, buyer willingness to pay, acceptable security architecture, or recurring failure volume for this entrant.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: At least two paid, independent consultant pilots using representative redacted or customer-controlled data, with pre/post measurements of reconciliation hours, defects caught, avoided rework, release throughput, deployment and support cost, security acceptance, renewal intent, and signed pricing that supports contribution margin after annual regression and qualified-review costs.
records.primary_score_limiter: The consultant payer-and-distribution mechanism has no demand evidence, and its fragmented customer-controlled deployments may simultaneously weaken willingness to adopt, gross margin, scalable support, and the accumulation of a defensible shared data advantage.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: ECHA already provides free preparation, validation, multimarket, and system-to-system tooling, while SAP and UL document incumbent PCN/UFI workflows; this directly undermines any value proposition based mainly on dossier generation or submission access and leaves the claimed exception-control advantage unproved.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A signed paid or binding conditional take-or-pay commitment from a named fleet, matched conditional host agreements granting legally reviewed exclusive bay, entry, and fallback rights, a documented compliant CPO/MSP allocation, and a 60-90 day pilot showing positive contribution after all host, platform, insurance, operator, service-credit, and fallback costs. The pilot should also report successful-session, blocked-bay, fault, fallback-use, support-minute, and renewal-intent metrics.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business requires a fleet to accept contribution-positive take-or-pay terms before reliability is proven and hosts to grant enforceable exclusive and fallback rights before demand is fully de-risked; neither side of that closing sequence nor the resulting contribution margin is evidenced.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Incumbent documentation shows that access groups, tariffs, cost tracking, and fleet reservations already exist, while Virta explicitly states that a digital reservation does not guarantee physical bay availability. This removes a software moat and forces the candidate's claimed advantage into costly, failure-prone site control and local operations.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: At least three independently sourced Polish or CEE supplier datasets should show material recoverable deductions left unresolved by current staff or systems, followed by paid fixed-scope audits that establish accepted pricing, attributable cash or labor value, bounded delivery hours, positive contribution margin after expert review and adviser share, and repeat eligible volume; at least one adviser should commit to commercial terms and produce qualified introductions.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business requires a narrow intersection of material unresolved deductions, complete authorized evidence, an inadequate incumbent workflow, budget, and adviser access, yet neither the size of that intersection nor repeatable profitable delivery has been shown.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: HighRadius documents nearly the full supplier-side capture, promotion-matching, evidence, dispute, and ERP workflow, while a Vistex case study reports meaningful deduction-processing improvement at a 200-plus-employee food producer; together they directly weaken the claim that the target job or mid-market customer is meaningfully underserved.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid pilots should demonstrate repeatable reductions in expert hours and validation failures, acceptance of the proposed security architecture, gross margin after onboarding and taxonomy maintenance, renewal intent, and at least one signed advisor channel commitment with measurable lead flow.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no direct evidence that the target segment will pay this entrant enough to overcome free official substitutes, priced specialist competition, security procurement, and service-heavy delivery.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The EBA and KNF provide the official data model, validation materials, current forms, examples, and free training, while both ServiceNow and a DORA-native vendor already offer register workflows and the specialist publishes annual pricing of EUR 1,500-12,500.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid pilots with several multi-SKU operators should show current release cost and error frequency, measurable time or rework reduction, acceptance of customer-controlled formula handling and foreign-user boundaries, realized specialist and translation cost, recurring change volume, renewal intent, and at least one consultant channel agreement with viable acquisition economics; explicit employer conflict clearance is also required.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no direct evidence that a sufficiently large, reachable small-operator segment will entrust formulations and pay recurring fees high enough to cover expert review, security, support, and regulatory maintenance, while free and incumbent alternatives are already available.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: ECHA already provides free preparation, validation, multimarket submission, and system-to-system tooling, and SAP and UL already support PCN workflows; additionally, the 2027 distributor obligation is narrowed when upstream information is already held, so neither tooling access nor the regulatory change alone establishes a valuable wedge.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A binding pilot dataset should show reachable retirement-event frequency, first-notice contract acceptance, chemistry-specific testing and compliance cost, non-waste qualification and sale rate, buyer-paid price, time to close, failed-case cost, insurance terms, and contribution margin relative to free EPR take-back; it should also benchmark realized outcomes against Cling, Circunomics, and direct recycler routes.
records.primary_score_limiter: The venture has not established a sufficiently frequent and profitable paid event: waste disposal has a free statutory route, while positive-value non-waste sales may be sparse and costly to prove.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The IEA evidence that second-life reuse remains constrained by safety, warranty, uncertain remaining life, repurposing cost, liability transfer, and falling new-battery prices directly threatens the depth and margin of the revised lawful non-waste transaction pool.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid, route-specific pilot with named fleets committing vehicles, schedules, and prices; at least five hosts granting legally reviewed firm access and parking rights; charger-level compatibility evidence; and observed results for successful-session rate, blocked bays, faults, support minutes, utilization, host payments, platform and compliance costs, acquisition cost, contribution per slot, and renewal intent.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that one micro-market contains enough simultaneously compatible host supply and recurring fleet willingness to pay to support reliable utilization and attractive contribution economics; the software layer is already commoditized.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Monta already supplies differentiated access, tariffs, roaming, and cost tracking, while Virta already supplies compatible-charger reservations and explicitly warns that a digital reservation does not guarantee physical bay availability. This directly weakens both differentiation and the proposed reliability advantage.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid design partnership with a named budget owner should establish an acceptable price and procurement path, followed by a counsel-approved live pilot that measures opt-in and consent persistence, precision and recall by payment rail, incremental benefit over a native block, support burden, total AISP and security cost, gross margin, and a renewal or expansion commitment.
records.primary_score_limiter: The intended distributors are simultaneously the budget holders, customer gatekeepers, and strongest build-or-buy substitutes, yet there is no evidence that any of them values the incremental workflow enough to pay a price that supports the proposed economics.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Revolut already provides Polish customers a free gambling block and Kontomatik already supplies a Polish gambling-transaction label; together these show that both basic intervention and core categorization can be delivered by institutions or established infrastructure vendors without this product.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid audits at several named producers or regional chains should establish lawful export rights, joinability across at least two operators, recurring exception or review-time value exceeding fees, operator-accepted adjustments where claimed, renewal intent, actual delivery margin, security and liability cost, and repeatable acquisition through a committed channel.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that recurring residual discrepancies or finance-review savings are large enough to support the proposed pricing after incumbent reporting, correction, audit, and inter-operator processes, and the vendor lacks control over both data access and adjustment acceptance.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Operators already offer APIs, settlement, reporting, anti-fraud, correction, and audit functions, five operators have formalized cooperation, and the reviewed materials identify no equivalent third-party data-access right; together this directly challenges both residual need and the independent vendor's control point.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Two or more paired-counterparty pilots using historical and live authorized data should document the incumbent-uncovered exception rate and value, baseline labor, recovered or prevented loss, resolution-speed improvement, evidence acceptance, onboarding and support hours, security requirements, and a signed recurring willingness-to-pay commitment; at least one integrator should also demonstrate a repeatable channel to similar accounts.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that a sufficiently large set of operators simultaneously has costly gaps left by incumbents, can authorize the necessary private bilateral feeds, and will pay an independent entrant to resolve them.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Gireve directly markets CDR quality checks, agreement-based price calculation, B2B invoicing, payment tracking, and dispute management, while Hubject already provides broad European OCPI/OICP clearing and documents exception reconciliation; this places nearly the entire proposed job inside established platforms.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Two or three contract-authorized Polish or CEE historical audits should show, against a written counterfactual, cash recovered or labor avoided that existing staff and systems would not have produced; they should also establish data completeness and permissions, a paid audit price, integration and review hours, time to value, contribution margin, a recurring budget owner, and at least one adviser-sourced repeatable acquisition path.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no demonstrated customer subset in which meaningful unrecovered deductions, complete and authorized data, adequate budget, and a genuine gap in existing staff or incumbent systems coexist; that missing intersection constrains economics, acquisition, and the attainable competitive position simultaneously.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: HighRadius explicitly markets portal and EDI capture, item-level promotion matching, external POS joins, evidence assembly, dispute submission, and ERP updates—nearly the proposed flow—while the Vistex case documents an integrated incumbent serving a 200-plus-employee food producer, directly weakening the claimed mid-market opening.
